items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: A critical code injection vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses CVE-2026-75650, a critical vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution and is being actively exploited.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that does not require authentication and could result in privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Another critical Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that does not require authentication and could result in privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation (B2B)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that does not require authentication and could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that does not require authentication and could enable a security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that requires authentication and could enable a security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session and escalate privileges. This vulnerability has been actively exploited.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
